paragraphs: Tarfon: Yuchasin lists R. Yudan ben Tarfon, but I have not found him. [Glosses: Tarfon. Bekhorot 11a, beginning: R. Yehudah Nesia had a firstborn donkey and brought it to R. Tarfon. Its correction requires investigation; it was not corrected.]
